Product Details: The Taparia Allen Keys Long Hex Ball Point Set, Model KBHM 9L, is a versatile and essential tool set designed for professional mechanics, technicians, and DIY enthusiasts. This comprehensive set features long-pattern hex keys with ball point ends, allowing you to access recessed fasteners and work at angles up to 25 degrees, making it ideal for hard-to-reach applications. The ball point design enables smooth engagement with socket head cap screws even when perfect alignment isn't possible, significantly improving efficiency during assembly and maintenance tasks. Manufactured by Taparia, a trusted name in hand tools, these allen keys are crafted from high-quality chrome vanadium steel for superior strength and durability. The long shaft design provides extended reach and enhanced leverage, whilst the precisely machined hex profile ensures a secure fit that minimises the risk of fastener damage. This set is perfect for automotive repairs, machinery maintenance, furniture assembly, and various industrial applications. The organised set configuration keeps your tools readily accessible and prevents loss, making it a valuable addition to any toolbox or workshop.
